svg.title: Region biomes
svg.desc: Four launch regions and two update regions, with palettes

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Brickabrac: four regions at launch, two wings to come

text.font-family: Nunito, Fredoka, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Launch: Downs, Crag, Fen, Flats. Then the Peaks (Update 2) and the Mines (Update 3). No background prop is orange, blue, teal or gold.
